official_sources.title: GDAL band scale, offset and unit contract
official_sources.finding: GDAL exposes band scale, offset and unit metadata; physical values are raw values multiplied by scale and then increased by offset, while RasterIO and ReadBlock do not automatically apply that conversion.
official_sources.limitation: Metadata can be absent, unsupported or wrong; scale and offset success flags and source identity remain mandatory.

official_sources.title: GDAL scale and offset success-state semantics
official_sources.finding: GetScale and GetOffset expose success indicators; returned defaults cannot be treated as authoritative metadata when the success state is false.
official_sources.limitation: Successful retrieval proves only metadata presence, not producer correctness or physical unit suitability.

official_sources.title: CF 1.13 packed-data requirements
official_sources.finding: CF packed data applies scale_factor and add_offset to stored values and requires missing-value attributes to be interpreted in the packed domain before unpacking.
official_sources.limitation: CF compliance does not establish a vertical datum or parcel-specific measurement accuracy.

official_sources.title: NetCDF attribute conventions for packed values
official_sources.finding: NetCDF conventions specify multiplication by scale_factor followed by add_offset, and require _FillValue and valid-range checks in the packed-data domain before scale and offset are applied.
official_sources.limitation: Libraries may expose raw or enhanced values differently; enhancement mode and API behavior must be pinned.

official_sources.title: CF conformance actual-range semantics
official_sources.finding: CF conformance requires actual_range to equal the minimum and maximum non-missing values after scale_factor and add_offset are applied.
official_sources.limitation: actual_range is only a metadata cross-check and cannot replace a full scan of the immutable raster and validity mask.

official_sources.title: OGC GeoTIFF vertical-unit requirements
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF 1.1 defines VerticalUnitsGeoKey for a vertical CRS axis and requires standard EPSG linear-unit codes for supported vertical units.
official_sources.limitation: A vertical unit without the matching vertical CRS, datum and operation is insufficient.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical unit conversion
official_sources.finding: PROJ unitconvert supports explicit vertical input and output units and defines conversion factors relative to metres for linear units.
official_sources.limitation: Unit conversion alone cannot transform between vertical datums or repair an unknown height reference.

official_sources.title: Rasterio band scales, offsets and units
official_sources.finding: Rasterio exposes per-band scales, offsets and units, enabling a library-independent snapshot and comparison with GDAL metadata.
official_sources.limitation: Matching library metadata does not prove that decoding was applied exactly once or that the declared unit belongs to the correct vertical CRS.
